context: Evaluates whether the model correctly uses OnFileDrop to register a file drop handler with the appropriate useDropTarget flag and OnFileDropOff to remove all listeners. The key challenge is knowing both function names, the correct callback signature (x, y, paths), and the meaning of the second boolean parameter.

checklist.name: OnFileDrop used
checklist.description: OnFileDrop from @wailsapp/runtime is called inside enableDrop

checklist.name: Handler argument passed
checklist.description: The handler (DropHandler callback) is passed as the first argument to OnFileDrop

checklist.name: dropTargetOnly flag passed
checklist.description: The dropTargetOnly boolean parameter is passed as the second argument (useDropTarget) to OnFileDrop

checklist.name: OnFileDropOff used
checklist.description: OnFileDropOff from @wailsapp/runtime is called (with no arguments) inside disableDrop
